panels.action: Ada leans over the mast rail and presses the brass signal key.
panels.beat: The routine dawn pulse leaves the mast.
panels.composition: Ada on the right third, lattice receding left, upper-left kept clear for caption
continuity: ada:copper headset band worn above the ears
relay-mast:fog-bleached steel lattice with oxidized copper cabling, lit only by a low grey dawn
panels.lighting: flat grey dawn from behind the fog with a weak copper glint on the cabling
panels.shot: wide establishing shot, camera slightly below the platform

text.content: Nine years of dawns. The same pulse into the same fog.

panels.action: Ada's hand freezes on the key as the needle swings back.
panels.composition: tight on Ada's face and the gauge, lower-right left open for dialogue
continuity: ada:pale burn scar across the left cheekbone
panels.lighting: cold fog light with a single copper reflection on the gauge glass

panels.action: Ada descends the wet basalt stair two steps at a time.
panels.beat: She carries the answer down to the town.
panels.composition: Ada small in frame on the left, stair falling away right, top kept clear
continuity: ada:grey canvas coat with a rolled left cuff
harbour-stair:wet basalt steps descending between fog-dulled lamp posts
panels.lighting: lamp posts blooming in fog, dawn brightening the stair below
panels.shot: high wide shot down the stair

text.content: Somebody out there is still transmitting.
